scripts.bundle: esbuild src/Startup.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --outfile=dist/bundle.js --sourcemap --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --external:jsdom --external:canvas && npm run bundle:copy-meta && npm run copy:jsdom-worker
scripts.bundle:copy-meta: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=['package.json','package-lock.json']; if(!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist'); for(const f of p) if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'dist/'+f);"
scripts.copy:jsdom-worker: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist | Out-Null; Copy-Item node_modules/jsdom/lib/jsdom/living/xhr/xhr-sync-worker.js dist/xhr-sync-worker.js"
